name: Atelier Amelia
old_description: Atelier Amelia is a New York-based garment manufacturer providing full-service support to established and emerging designer labels. Our team of experts offers comprehensive solutions, including sample development, pattern making, marking, grading, tech pack creation, production, and fitting services. We understand that each client is unique, and we work with them to create a customized approach that meets their specific needs and requirements.
about:
Atelier Amelia was founded in 2016 by designer Zhu Ru Chen in New York City. After struggling to find reliable manufacturers for her own swimwear line, Chen established the company to provide emerging brands with high-quality production and a personal touch.

The company operates a full-service sample room and production factory in New York, offering sample development, pattern making, marking, grading, tech pack creation, garment production, fitting services, sourcing, and technical specifications. Its in-house facility can produce 3,000 to 5,000 pieces per month while accommodating smaller runs with flexible quantities.

Atelier Amelia serves established and emerging designer labels across apparel and fashion categories. Clients include brands like Maiden Name, whose co-founder Alix Freireich has worked with the factory since 2019. The company focuses on designers launching their own lines, often investing personal capital.

The founder’s firsthand experience drives the company’s emphasis on quality, precision, and seamless collaboration. Atelier Amelia champions Made-in-NY manufacturing, supports emerging talent, and is integrating 3D fitting technology to reduce cost and lead time.
